$description: Component tokens for Checkbox. Path grammar: checkbox.<part>.<property>[.<size>][.<state>]: colors vary by state only, dimensions and type by size. Parts, options and states must exist in packages/components/specs/components/checkbox.spec.json. Values alias semantic tokens only (Figma library mapped colors and scales, and the additions).

column-gap.$description: Between the control and the label column.

row-gap.$description: Between the label and its description.

gap.$description: Before the message, after the description or, without one, the label: the Forms family's part gap (form.container.gap, 6 px; rule spacing, decision forms-part-gaps).

control.$description: The box: a native checkbox drawn by the component. The mark (check or bar) is drawn in its color token.

checked-error.$description: The fill of a checked box in error: its brand fill, the role of control.background.checked, inside its error border; the border and the message carry the error (decision checked-error-fill, Forms forms-choice-error-fill). A token for two states: it applies when the box is checked and in error, and wins over control.background.checked and control.background.error (packages/tokens/AGENTS.md, Which token applies).

indeterminate-error.$description: The fill of an indeterminate box in error: its brand fill, the role of control.background.indeterminate, inside its error border (decision checked-error-fill, Forms forms-choice-error-fill). A token for two states: it applies when the box is indeterminate and in error, and wins over control.background.indeterminate and control.background.error.

error.$description: The fill of an unchecked box in error, inside its error border, at rest and on hover alike: the subtle error background, as a field in error (Forms foundation, decisions forms-severity-fill and forms-choice-error-fill); a checked or indeterminate box keeps its brand fill (control.background.checked-error, indeterminate-error). The border and the message carry the error, the tint is not the cue.

border-color.$description: The border at rest keeps global.border.accent.neutral.default, an override of the Forms family's default (form.control.border-color.default, the field family's base neutral border) until this control's own refinement (decision form-family-aliases).

color.$description: Color of the mark: the check when checked, the bar when indeterminate.

typography.$description: Description text per control size: small takes the Forms family's size (form.description.font-size.small, 12 px); medium keeps body.size.sm (14 px), an override of the family's 12 px until the Checkbox's own refinement (decision form-family-aliases).

message.$description: What is wrong and what to do, under the description, aligned with the label (Forms decision forms-message-part-every-control).

typography.$description: Message text: the Forms family's message sizes per control size (form.message.font-size: body.size.sm, md), larger than the description, so the message that says what to fix reads as easily as the control; medium weight, the normal line height and the normal letter spacing (Forms foundation, rule anatomy, decisions forms-text-sizes and forms-token-family).
